name: Semaphore CI API
tagline: CI/CD API for projects, pipelines, promotions, and secrets with monorepo support
description: Semaphore provides a REST API for managing CI/CD projects, pipelines, promotions, secrets, and related resources. The API enables automation of builds, deployments, and monorepo workflows. Authentication uses API tokens. Docs and pricing should be verified from official sources for current endpoints, free-tier limits, and rate limits.

auth.details: API token authentication; verify exact header/scheme from current docs

pricing.free_tier_limits: $15 in free credits each month (≈2,000 Ubuntu x64 2-vCPU minutes); 20 concurrent jobs by default; artifacts free up to 20 GB/month egress and 100 GB/month storage; 9.6 GB cache storage per project.

example.request: curl -H "Authorization: Token YOUR_API_TOKEN" -H "User-Agent: SemaphoreCI v2.0 Client" -H "Accept: application/json" "https://YOUR_ORG.semaphoreci.com/api/v1alpha/pipelines?project_id=PROJECT_ID"
